summary: ORDER RECEIPT EMAIL FEATURE VERIFIED (backend-only). Added /app/backend/tests/test_email_receipts.py with 12 tests covering (a) email_service module load + env: EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY starts with 'ek_', EMAIL_FROM_NAME='Konphlux', EMAIL_BASE_URL is the hard-coded Emergent proxy constant; (b) live send via send_order_receipt(to='delivered@resend.dev', name='Ada Lovelace', order={id,amount_cents,lines}) — the Emergent proxy returned a non-null email id (200/202); (c) _assert_safe_email guardrails: rejects <form>/<input>, credential-ask phrases, non-https links, and accepts the fixed server-side template; (d) fulfillment idempotency end-to-end: register@example.com → POST /api/cart (b2) → POST /api/checkout returns cs_test_ session + checkout.stripe.com URL, /orders empty → await server._fulfill_paid_order(session_id) → order.payment_status='paid', status='paid', cart cleared, email_sent=True, /api/orders returns the paid order (no _id) → second call to _fulfill_paid_order with a spy patched onto both email_service.send_order_receipt AND server.send_order_receipt confirms 0 additional sends and email_sent remains True; (e) regression: POST /api/checkout still returns cs_test_ + checkout_url, POST /api/stripe/webhook (secret blank) returns 200 {received:true}, auth guards on /cart /checkout /orders all 401/403. Full pytest suite 75/75 PASS in 10.72s (test_konphlux_api.py auth/districts/feed/bazaar/saves/chatmonger/profile + test_roundtable.py communities/threads/replies/votes + test_cart_checkout.py cart CRUD & checkout + test_webhook.py + new test_email_receipts.py). No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues introduced (backend-only change).
action_items: (NONE blocking) Feature is verified end-to-end. Optional polish: server.py has grown past 1000 lines (now ~1024) — consider splitting into routers modules (auth, cart/checkout, roundtable, chatmonger, email). Carried from iter 5/6.
(LOW) server.py still uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — deprecated by FastAPI in favour of lifespan handlers. Non-functional, just deprecation warnings during tests.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py:100-119 (_send_email): correctly enforces guardrail _first_, uses the Emergent-managed proxy as a CONSTANT (never env-read), sends X-Email-Key header, returns the response id or None on failure. Good.

email_service.py:126-159 (send_order_receipt): body is 100% server-templated from the persisted order record; caller cannot inject html/subject/recipient overrides. Recipient is passed explicitly from server-side buyer record. Meets G1/G2/G3 guardrails.

server.py:924-944 (_fulfill_paid_order): idempotent — marks order paid, clears cart, only sends email if not order.email_sent, then sets email_sent=True. Uses fresh DB read for the order dict passed to email builder so amount/lines match persisted state. Exception on send is caught so a failed email cannot block fulfillment.
server.py:947-961 (checkout_status): pulls latest Stripe session and calls _fulfill_paid_order on paid — idempotent path also routes through the same fulfillment code as the webhook.

server.py:981-995 (stripe_webhook): returns 200 {received:true, note:'…'} when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (dev/test); verifies signature and only fulfills on checkout.session.completed with payment_status=='paid'. Safe.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 ephemeral test users this run: test_receipt_*@example.com (one per fulfillment test) and test_cart_*/test_other_*@example.com from existing suites. Each creates one pending order in db.orders; the fulfillment test paid-marks one order and sends one real receipt email via the Emergent proxy to delivered@resend.dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order-receipt email flow: server-side ONLY. `from email_service import send_order_receipt` is called inside server._fulfill_paid_order(session_id) which is invoked from BOTH GET /api/checkout/status/{sid} (poll) AND POST /api/stripe/webhook (checkout.session.completed + paid). Idempotency key is order.email_sent — verified with a monkey-patched send_order_receipt (must patch both email_service.send_order_receipt AND server.send_order_receipt because server imported the symbol at load). Stripe hosted checkout cannot complete headlessly; drive the paid path by directly awaiting server._fulfill_paid_order(session_id). EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY / EMAIL_FROM_NAME are read from backend/.env; EMAIL_BASE_URL is a hard-coded constant. To send a real test email, use to='delivered@resend.dev'. All 4 test suites now run together: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest tests/ --asyncio-mode=auto` — 75 tests, ~11s.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The order-receipt email feature is implemented correctly. The Emergent proxy returned a non-null email id for a real send to delivered@resend.dev, guardrails reject unsafe html, fulfillment marks the order paid + clears cart + sends exactly one receipt, and a second _fulfill_paid_order call for the same session does not resend (email_sent stays True). /api/orders reflects the paid order post-fulfillment. Existing regression (auth, districts, feed, bazaar, roundtable, cart, checkout, webhook) unaffected.
